_comment: For the IAM USER the service assistant signs with. Not a role: this box is
Lightsail, which carries an AWS managed role and cannot be given a custom
instance profile, so there is nothing to attach a role to.
Start and stop are pinned to one instance ARN, so this key cannot touch
anything else in the account even if it leaks. The describe actions cannot
be narrowed the same way: AWS does not support resource level permissions
on them. They are read only, so what a leak buys is the ability to list
instances, which is an acceptable trade for what this key is for.
Replace ACCOUNT_ID and GPU_INSTANCE_ID before using it.
